svg.title: comma 3
svg.desc: FrogPilot (driver-assistance software for cars) device icon: the front of a comma 3, which the comma 3X shares, with openpilot engaged on its screen behind a green border, showing a coastal road with the green path, the set speed, speed limit sign, and current speed, and a map with the route, destination pin, and next turn, above the pod holding the driver camera and its two infrared LEDs.
